en: Yesterday: three boxes, and every single label was wrong.
The answer is box 3, the box with the Mixed label.
Its label is wrong, so it cannot be mixed. It holds only one kind of fruit.
Pull out an apple? Then that box is the apples.
The box labelled Oranges cannot be oranges, so it must be the mixed one. And the last box is oranges.
Three light switches on a wall. Only one of them turns on the lamp.
The lamp is in another room, behind a closed door. From here, you cannot see it.
Person 1 says: flip the switches as many times as you like.
But you may open that door only once.
No helpers. No cameras. One visit.
So how do you find the right switch?
Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
